before.title: Dashboard Melting and Sticky Surface
before.description: The GS dashboard suffers from the same melting and sticky surface defect as other Lexus models of this era. Heat exposure causes the dashboard material to chemically degrade, resulting in a shiny, tacky surface that creates dangerous glare on the windshield. This was a widespread issue across the Lexus lineup.
before.solution: Lexus Customer Support Program ZE7 covers dashboard replacement. Contact your dealer or Lexus customer support at 1-800-255-3987. The entire dashboard assembly and associated trim panels are replaced with redesigned materials.
symptoms: Dashboard surface becomes sticky to touch
Reflective glare on windshield from melted dashboard
Chemical smell from dashboard in warm weather

citations.title: NHTSA complaint cluster — Lexus GS dashboard melting defect (500+ complaints)

communityRecommendations.content: Use a windshield sun shade religiously to slow the dashboard deterioration. Document the condition with photos as evidence for your warranty claim.

proposal.title: Dashboard Melting and Sticky Surface
proposal.description: The available Lexus primary records do not support this page’s 2006-2012 GS dashboard scope. L-SB-0011-15 begins GS coverage with 2013 GS350/GS450h and 2016 GS200t/GS F vehicles. A NHTSA metadata row associates a 2008 GS350 with ZLD, but visual review of the actual 31-page ZLD packet shows no GS model in its applicability list. The current ZE7 program name, dangerous-glare conclusion, 500+ complaint citation and lineup-wide claim therefore remain unsupported.
proposal.solution: Do not promise ZE7 coverage or dashboard replacement from this page. Have a Lexus dealer inspect the condition and verify the VIN against current Lexus program and service information; any historical enhancement coverage was time-limited. Avoid solvent, coating or trim-removal experiments that could worsen the surface or affect adjacent safety components. No universal retail part or dealer-only remedy is asserted.
proposal.contentUpdateSummary: Removed the unsupported ZE7/complaint/glare claims and documented the conflict between NHTSA row metadata and the actual ZLD/L-SB applicability; held the 2006-2012 identity for exact evidence.

before.title: Power Steering Rack Seal Leak
before.description: The power steering rack develops internal seal leaks that cause power steering fluid loss. The leak typically appears at the inner tie rod boots where fluid seeps past the rack seals. Low fluid levels lead to increased steering effort and pump whining noise, and eventually the rack must be replaced.
before.solution: Replace the power steering rack assembly. Remanufactured racks are available from Maval and Cardone at significant savings over new OEM. Perform a complete power steering fluid flush after installation. Inspect tie rods and replace if worn.
symptoms: Power steering fluid leaking from rack area
Whining noise when turning steering wheel
Increased steering effort especially at low speed

citations.title: ClubLexus.com — GS steering rack leak diagnosis and replacement options

communityRecommendations.content: Check the inner tie rod boots regularly for fluid wetness — this is the earliest sign of a leaking rack. Catching it early prevents pump damage from running low on fluid.

proposal.title: Power Steering Rack Seal Leak
proposal.description: The complete GS communication inventory does not support a hydraulic rack-seal leak across the page’s 2006-2015 scope. For certain 2006-2007 GS vehicles, Lexus Special Service Campaign 9LC instead documents an Electric Power Steering Link assembly whose motor could lose torque and increase low-speed steering effort. That electric system evidence conflicts with this page’s fluid-loss, pump-whine and tie-rod-boot mechanism.
proposal.solution: Do not add power-steering fluid, flush a hydraulic system, or purchase a Maval/Cardone rack from this page. If steering effort changes, record the VIN, warning lamps and when the condition occurs; ask Lexus to verify campaign 9LC completion where applicable and diagnose the installed steering system under current service information. Treat a sudden steering-assist change as safety-critical. No universal retail part or dealer-only remedy is asserted.

before.title: Water Pump Premature Failure
before.description: The water pump on the GS models fails prematurely, typically between 60,000-100,000 miles. Coolant leaks from the weep hole as the internal seal deteriorates, and the pump bearing develops play causing a whining noise. If not addressed, overheating and potential engine damage can occur.
before.solution: Replace the water pump assembly and thermostat together as a preventive measure. Use OEM or high-quality aftermarket parts (Aisin brand is the OEM supplier). Replace the serpentine belt and tensioner at the same time if they show wear.
symptoms: Coolant leak from front of engine
Whining noise from water pump area at idle
Sweet coolant smell from engine bay

citations.title: ClubLexus.com — GS350 water pump failure pattern and replacement guide

communityRecommendations.content: Aisin WPT-190 water pump — this is the actual OEM supplier for Toyota/Lexus water pumps at a fraction of the dealer price. Identical quality.

proposal.title: Water Pump Premature Failure
proposal.description: L-SB-0039-20 provides water-pump leak inspection guidance for 2016-2019 GS200t/GS300 and 2019-2020 GS350 vehicles. It distinguishes temporary dry coolant residue from an active leak and does not establish a 60,000-100,000-mile premature-failure pattern, the page’s 2013-2015 scope or a universal bearing/seal diagnosis. The bulletin also does not validate Aisin WPT-190 across the listed trims and engines.
proposal.solution: Confirm the exact VIN/model-year applicability and inspect under L-SB-0039-20. Dry residue can represent a temporary condition that does not require pump replacement; an active wet leak, low reservoir level with an apparent leak, or excessive pulley/bearing play requires the model-specific repair procedure. Do not automatically replace the thermostat, belt or tensioner, and do not order WPT-190 from this page. No universal retail part or dealer-only remedy is asserted.
